scope: 74 publication PDFs: source and figure-alternative review, native reading-order and formal PDF/UA repairs, and synchronized Markdown/figure downloads.

visual_review.coverage_limit: Layout overview of every page; detailed figure/heading/table/order checks as recorded. Not every prose line at full resolution or an all-page assistive-technology user test.

verification.appearance: 1,024 pages in 73 changed PDFs are pixel-identical in MuPDF 1.28.2 and Poppler 26.01.0 at 144 DPI; Myers 2013 remains byte-identical (4 pages).
